text_en: Simeon Peter, a servant and apostle of Jesus Christ, To those who have received a faith as precious as ours through the righteousness of our God and Savior Jesus Christ:
text_cn: 耶稣基督的仆人和宗徒西满伯多禄，致书给那些因我们的天主和救主耶稣基督的正义，与我们分享同样宝贵信德的人。

text_en: May grace and peace be yours in abundance in the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord.
text_cn: 愿恩宠与平安，因认识天主和我们的主耶稣，丰富地赐予你们。

text_en: His divine power has given us everything needed for life and godliness, through the knowledge of him who called us by his own glory and goodness.
text_cn: 因为我们认识了那藉自己的光荣和德能，召叫我们的基督，基督天主性的大能，就将各种关乎生命和虔敬的恩惠，赏给了我们，

text_en: Thus he has given us, through these things, his precious and very great promises, so that through them you may escape from the corruption that is in the world because of lust, and may become participants of the divine nature.
text_cn: 并藉着自己的光荣和德能，将最大和宝贵的恩许赏给了我们，为使你们藉着这些恩许，在逃脱世界上所有败坏的贪欲之后，能成为有分于天主性体的人。

text_en: For this very reason, you must make every effort to support your faith with goodness, and goodness with knowledge,
text_cn: 正为了这个原故，你们要全力奋勉，在你们的信仰上还要加毅力，在毅力上加知识，

text_en: and knowledge with self-control, and self-control with endurance, and endurance with godliness,
text_cn: 在知识上加节制，在节制上加忍耐，在忍耐上加虔敬，

text_en: and godliness with mutual affection, and mutual affection with love.
text_cn: 在虔敬上加兄弟的友爱，在兄弟的友爱上加爱德。

text_en: For if these things are yours and are increasing among you, they keep you from being ineffective and unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.
text_cn: 实在，这些德行如果存在你们内，且不断增添，你们决不致于在认识我们的主耶稣基督上，成为不工作，不结果实的人，

text_en: For anyone who lacks these things is short-sighted and blind, and is forgetful of the cleansing of past sins.
text_cn: 因为那没有这些德行的，便是瞎子，是近视眼，忘却了他从前的罪恶已被清除。

text_en: Therefore, brothers and sisters, be all the more eager to confirm your call and election, for if you do this, you will never stumble.
text_cn: 为此，弟兄们，你们更要尽心竭力，使你们的蒙召和被选，赖善行而坚定不移；倘若你们这样作，决不会跌倒。

text_en: For in this way, entry into the eternal kingdom of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ will be richly provided for you.
text_cn: 的确，这样你们便更有把握，进入我们的主和救主耶稣基督永远的国。

text_en: Therefore I intend to keep on reminding you of these things, though you know them already and are established in the truth that has come to you.
text_cn: 为此，纵然你们已知道这些事，已坚定在所怀有的真理之上，我还是要常提醒你们。

text_en: I think it right, as long as I am in this body, to refresh your memory,
text_cn: 我以为只要我还在这帐幕内，就有义务以劝言来鼓励你们。

text_en: since I know that my death will come soon, as indeed our Lord Jesus Christ has made clear to me.
text_cn: 我知道我的帐幕快要拆卸了，一如我们的主耶稣基督指示给我的。

text_en: And I will make every effort so that after my departure you may be able at any time to recall these things.
text_cn: 我要尽心竭力使你们在我去世以后，也时常记念这些事。

text_en: For we did not follow cleverly devised myths when we made known to you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but we had been eyewitnesses of his majesty.
text_cn: 我们将我们的主耶稣基督的大能和来临，宣告给你们，并不是依据虚构的荒诞故事，而是因为我们亲眼见过他的威荣。

text_en: For he received honor and glory from God the Father when that voice was conveyed to him by the Majestic Glory, saying, “This is my Son, my Beloved, with whom I am well pleased. ”
text_cn: 他实在由天主接受了尊敬和光荣，因那时曾有这样的声音，从显赫的光荣中发出来，向他说：“这是我的爱子，我所喜悦的。”

text_en: We ourselves heard this voice come from heaven, while we were with him on the holy mountain.
text_cn: 这来自天上的声音，是我们同他在那座圣山上的时候，亲自听见的。

text_en: So we have the prophetic message more fully confirmed. You will do well to be attentive to this as to a lamp shining in a dark place, until the day dawns and the morning star rises in your hearts.
text_cn: 因此，我们认定先知的话更为确实，对这话你们当十分留神，就如留神在暗中发光的灯，直到天亮，晨星在你们的心中升起的时候。

text_en: First of all you must understand this, that no prophecy of scripture is a matter of one’s own interpretation,
text_cn: 最主要的，你们应知道经上的一切预言，决不应随私人的解释，

text_en: because no prophecy ever came by human will, but men and women moved by the Holy Spirit spoke from God.
text_cn: 因为预言从来不是由人的意愿而发的，而是由天主所派遣的圣人，在圣神推动之下说出来的。
